scope: AI Options only: verified authentication identity, React Query cache and post-login prefetch
environment: Local Node test runner and jsdom, real AuthProvider/QueryClient/hooks, synthetic API responses; no external HTTP or customer data
verified: A verified account switch refetches configuration, provider catalog and voice catalog without reusing the previous account's data
A held response from the previous identity cannot populate the current profile or restore the departed identity's cache
Unverified and tenantless identities start neither queries nor prefetch
Post-login prefetch repeats after a tenant switch even when the user ID is unchanged and the editor is not mounted
React StrictMode effect replay with an already verified identity keeps active observers usable and discards the canceled first response
remaining_boundary: CP08: these responses do not carry authenticated ownership stamps. This evidence does not close the interval where another tab replaces cookies before the local identity-change marker is received. It does not certify all cross-tab HTTP attribution or production readiness.
